name: web-request
instructions: This is a web automation/web request task.
You are running in Codex CLI mode.
Use Codex internal web capabilities/tools to fulfill the request end-to-end.
Do not leave web tasks running in the background; wait for completion before returning JSON.
If the user asks to show/display/view a page, the outcome must include a screenshot.
For all web runs, do not wait for user interaction and do not keep sessions open.
If user gives a bare domain (e.g. www.example.com), treat it as https://www.example.com.
If critical information is missing, ask one concise follow-up question instead of guessing.
Return ONLY a single JSON object with this exact top-level shape:
If asking a follow-up question, set follow_up_question and set reply to an empty string.
If no binary output is produced, set binaries to an empty array.
If you create files like screenshots, include each output file in binaries with a valid local path.
Do not return markdown, code fences, or extra keys.

output_schema.binaries: array of objects with path:string, filename?:string, content_type?:string, purpose?:string
